categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, cadastral maps, and property encumbrances. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses entirely on land registration and property rights, fitting perfectly within the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
